task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.
joint_plan_text:
### Joint Plan — task8_abstract  (about 5 min / deadline 20 min: OK)

[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] prepare the green plastic cup for use in another room  (r1_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] place the red blanket neatly on the purple sofa  (r2_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] place the green pillow on the wooden bed  (r3_s1)
- R1 [PASS] pass green plastic cup (on the counter, image 1) to R2 (offered) (hands it over; R2 collects it)  (r1_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] spread the black and white blanket on the wooden bed  (r3_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] receive green plastic cup (on the counter, image 1) from R1 (collects it from the kitchen)  (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] move the green plastic cup to the wooden coffee table  (r2_s4)

- R3 [RECEIVE] receive green plastic cup (on the counter, image 1) (green plastic cup (on the counter, image 1)) — withdrawn: the step it enabled (r3_s4) was released (by rule)
